Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR product/eng readout: pulse, timeline, and risks

Team —

Attaching the first-pass pulse for the product + eng readout we'll present in the QBR. High level asks:

- Can each of you scan for any timeline changes or new delivery risks by EOD Tue (6/1)? call out risk owner and mitigation.
- Karthik: confirm whether the mid-June data platform cutover still holds for the public beta timeline.
- Marissa: note any go/no-go gating criteria we'll want on the SLAs.

Attachment: QBR_Product_Eng_Pulse_v1.xlsx (contains: summary tab, timeline Gantt, risk register)

Quick summary excerpt:
- Shipping: feature set A on track; feature set B has two tech-blockers requiring infra support (see risk #4).
- Beta timeline: public beta target still mid-June but dependent on data platform cutover; fallback is late-June.
- Metrics: latency SLO delta expected during first 48h of beta; estimated cost delta ~12%.

I framed the narrative for leadership: de-risk plan (canary, regional fallback), decision points (beta go/no-go on 6/15), and escalation path. We'll iterate the risk register in the sheet — please add inline notes rather than separate threads.

Thanks,
Hannah

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QBR product/eng readout: pulse, timeline, and risks

Thanks — reviewed and left row-level comments in the sheet. Quick notes inline here: 

> - data platform cutover 
The cutover window remains mid-June but the current rollback plan depends on an infra-side DB replica that is still queued behind two priority infra tickets. Risk owner: me. Mitigation: carve a 48h maintenance window and reserve on-call coverage; alternative is to run the beta against a read-only snapshot for the first 24h. Likelihood: medium; impact: high.

> - infra support for feature set B
I've escalated ticket INF-321 to infra leads; tentative swimlane cleared but gating PRs still pending. Risk owner: marissa (ops gating), engineering owner: me.

Proposed timeline tweak: move the decision checkpoint to 6/14 for internal readiness, keep public beta target 6/16 with a soft rollout plan (10% traffic first 2 days). I'll update the Gantt and add a short note under the 'decision logic' column.

Also adding a new risk: 'third-party auth provider rate limits' — seen sporadic 429s in load test; impact on signups. Risk owner: marissa.

- K
